record.name: LALAL.AI: Vocal Remover
record.offering: Music app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
The #1 AI vocal remover, now in your pocket. Loved by millions of musicians, producers and creators — and a Webby People's Voice winner.
Remove vocals or instrumentals from any song or video in seconds, in studio quality. Powered by unique AI, LALAL.AI separates voice and accompaniment with pinpoint accuracy and leaves no vocals behind.
It's the go-to tool for musicians, producers, dancers, vocalists, DJs, content creators and karaoke fans. Build your own karaoke track, song cover, mashup, remix, sample, beat or TikTok sound — right from your phone.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Remove vocals & instrumentals — split any track into voice and accompaniment in seconds.
Isolate instruments — extract drums, bass, piano, acoustic guitar, electric guitar, synthesizer, plus string and wind instruments.
Make karaoke & acapella — get a clean instrumental for singing or an isolated vocal for remixing.
Cancel background noise — strip unwanted sounds to clean up voice, vocals or speech.
Work with video too — import MP4, MKV and AVI, not just audio.
Keep original quality — stems come back in the same bitrate and format as the source, with no quality loss.
Preview before you export — listen to every result in the in-app player, then download only what you need.
Separate lead & backing vocals — pull the main voice apart from the background harmonies.
Remove echo & reverb — clean up roomy recordings for clearer, more usable vocals.

SUPPORTED FORMATS

Import: MP3, OGG, WAV, FLAC, AIFF, AAC, AVI, MP4, MKV. Export your stems in the same format as the original file.

HOW TO USE

Tap "Add Files" to upload your audio or video.
Choose the stem you want to remove or isolate.
Preview the result in the player.
Download the full stem.

PRICING

Start for free — preview any separation at no cost before you commit. Pay only for what you process with simple minute packs. No forced subscription.

DISCLAIMER

We strongly recommend against uploading content that includes third-party intellectual property (such as copyrighted material) unless you have permission from that party to do so. Users are legally responsible for the content they upload to the application.

Feel free to contact us at support@lalal.ai — your feedback and ideas are important to us! For more LALAL.AI news and tutorials, follow us on YouTube @LALAL.AI.

record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
RealTalk is an AI-powered assistant built for licensed real estate agents. Ask questions in plain English and get instant answers backed by real MLS data.

SEARCH LISTINGS
Describe the types of properties you're looking for in plain English. You'll get results in seconds.

PULL COMPS
Get comparable sales for any address with similarity scoring. Find the best comps by property features, similarity, and AI image analysis to deliver a data-backed pricing recommendation to your clients.

ANALYZE MARKETS
Ask about inventory levels, median prices, days on market, price trends, and more. Break down stats by area, property type, or price range.

MANAGE YOUR LISTINGS
View all your active, pending, and closed listings in one place. Get pricing reviews, marketing prep, and honest feedback on how to improve.

RESEARCH AGENTS & OFFICES
Look up agent production data, transaction volume, and office performance in your market.

HOW IT WORKS
Just type what you need: "pull comps for 123 Main St," "show me homes under $500K in Scottsdale with a pool," or "how's the luxury market in my zip code trending?" Artie understands context and responds with plain English backed by real listing data.

Your conversations are saved so you can pick up where you left off. Start with one of six quick-action prompts or ask anything.

MLS-VERIFIED DATA
RealTalk connects directly to your MLS through a secure verification process. Your data stays current and accurate.

BUILT FOR AGENTS, BY AGENTS
This app requires a valid MLS membership. It is not a consumer-facing home search tool.

record.name: Rehearsable: Sales Practice
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
You don't get better at selling by reading about selling. You get better by doing it, out loud, over and over.

Rehearsable is a flight simulator for sales conversations. You talk to an AI buyer that actually pushes back, then get scored on how you handled it. Cold call or warm intro, discovery, demo, objection handling, negotiation, the close. Practice the moments that decide the deal until they stop scaring you, instead of burning a real opportunity to find out.

How it works:

Tell it who you sell. Your company, your product, the kind of buyer you talk to.
Pick a buyer. Friendly, busy, skeptical, or flat-out hostile. Voice or text.
Run the conversation. They probe, object, go quiet, test you. You handle it live.
Get scored. Rapport, discovery, value, objection handling, closing, plus the exact moments you won or lost the room.

With Pro you get:

Unlimited text rehearsals and live voice calls
AI buyers that behave like real ones, at any stage of the deal
Custom personas built around the people you actually sell to
Detailed scoring and skill trends, so you can see what's sharpening and what still needs work
Built for SDRs, AEs, and anyone who would rather fumble in here than on a live deal. For managers: spin up a team, run tournaments, and see who is actually putting in the reps.

Stop winging the conversations that pay you. Rehearse them.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://rehearsable.io/terms
Privacy Policy: https://rehearsable.io/privacy

record.name: Closer Coach AI
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Turn every sales call into coaching.

Closer Coach records or imports your sales calls, transcribes them privately on your iPhone, and gives you an honest Close Score in under a minute — then coaches you a little sharper every single day.

Most tools record your calls and hand you a dashboard. Closer Coach is different: it's a coach. It tells you exactly what to do on your next call, and holds you to it.

HOW IT WORKS
- Record a live call, or import one from your phone
- It transcribes on-device — your audio never leaves your iPhone
- Get a Close Score across five competencies: discovery, rapport, objection handling, closing, and locking the next step
- See your talk-to-listen ratio, a tonality read, and an objection-by-objection breakdown
- Every day, a two-minute check-in judges your last focus and hands you the one thing to fix

WHAT YOU GET
- An AI sales coach that adapts to how YOU sell, learned from your real calls
- A daily plan: an on-call challenge, a practice drill, and a coaching pep-talk
- Pre-call briefs — enter who you're calling and get a game plan, openers, likely objections with rebuttals, and discovery questions, tuned to your weak spots
- A full-memory coach chat that actually knows your calls
- Your Closer Level and rank, climbing as your close rate does

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Transcription runs on your device. Your call audio never leaves your phone — only the transcript text is used to coach you, and even the pep-talk is synthesized on-device.

FOR CLOSERS, SDRs, AEs & FOUNDERS
Booking meetings, running demos, or closing deals — if you sell on the phone, Closer Coach makes you sharper, one call at a time.

Start free. Go Premium for the daily edge.

Closer Coach provides sales-performance coaching, not legal advice — you are responsible for recording calls lawfully. A product of Emouna LLC.

SHOP WITH MORE CLARITY

Hauljoy AI is your AI shopping assistant when you are unsure what to buy, which option to choose, or whether an item fits your needs. Joy helps you compare products, understand buyer feedback, monitor prices, explore alternatives, and make a more informed decision.

ASK IN YOUR OWN WAY

Start with text or a supported product link. When available, use voice or upload a product photo. Share your needs, budget, intended use, must-have features, and doubts. Joy turns that context into shopping advice and comparison points. Ask follow-up questions to focus on what matters most.

PERSONALIZED PRODUCT RECOMMENDATIONS

Get product recommendations based on your needs, price range, use case, and preferences. Use Joy with a shortlist, a broad need, or a question about important trade-offs. When relevant information is available, Joy explains why an option may fit.

PRODUCT COMPARISON

Compare products side by side by price, features, pros and cons, practical uses, trade-offs, and overall value. Product comparison helps you identify meaningful differences, ask better questions, and narrow a crowded shortlist without rushing your decision.

PRICE TRACKER, ALERTS, AND WATCHLIST

Add supported product links, save items you are considering, and use the price tracker to monitor available price information over time. Keep a product watchlist for items you want to revisit. When a saved price changes and relevant information is available, price alerts can help you review the update before deciding whether to buy or wait.

REVIEW SUMMARIES

Joy organizes available buyer feedback into helpful review summaries, including common advantages, disadvantages, recurring concerns, and useful observations. Use them as additional context, and check the original product and merchant information before purchasing.

PHOTO PRODUCT SEARCH

When photo analysis is available, upload a product photo and ask Joy to help identify or analyze it. Photo product search can help you explore possible matches, understand useful features, compare similar options, and ask more specific shopping questions.

GIFT IDEAS FOR DIFFERENT OCCASIONS

Ask for gift ideas based on the occasion, recipient, budget, interests, style, or practical needs. Explore suggestions for birthdays, holidays, thank-you gifts, and last-minute planning.

DEALS, FAVORITES, AND ORGANIZATION

When relevant information is available, explore deals, discounts, coupons, and value-focused options. Save favorites, organize products by category, and compare them again later. Hauljoy AI can act as a product finder and shopping companion.

MAKE A THOUGHTFUL DECISION

Use Hauljoy AI when comparing similar products, deciding whether a higher-priced option is worthwhile, reviewing lots of feedback, or saving an item for later. Joy helps you understand the trade-offs and choose with greater confidence. The final decision remains yours.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

Purchases are completed through third-party merchant websites or apps. Product details, prices, availability, reviews, deals, and links can change and may not be complete or current. Features and information may vary by product, merchant, and region. Hauljoy AI does not guarantee the lowest price, a specific saving, a product match, or a purchase outcome. Confirm specifications, seller terms, availability, and final price before buying.

Start a conversation with Joy for clearer information and a second opinion before you buy.

record.description_evidence:
SkyUp is the #1 up system for automotive dealerships, furniture stores, RV dealerships, boat dealerships, appliance stores, flooring stores, jewelry stores, and any retail store where you have sales reps on the floor.

If you've been in retail sales, you know the problem. Salespeople fighting over customers. Cherry-picking the easy ups. No accountability for who talked to whom. Customers waiting while reps argue about whose turn it is. SkyUp fixes all of it — automatically.

WHAT SKYUP DOES

Up Rotation — Every customer is automatically assigned to the next rep in queue. Fair, consistent, and instant. No manual tracking. No arguments.

Instant Alerts — Reps receive a push notification the moment a customer is assigned to them. They can be anywhere on the floor and still know when it's their turn.

Complete Traffic Tracking — Log walk-ins, be-backs, and appointments separately. Track 100% of your actual store traffic for the first time.

Real-Time Dashboard — Managers see the entire floor at a glance from any device. Who is with a customer? Who just finished? Who is next up?

Outcome Logging — After each up, reps answer a few quick questions about the outcome — quote, test drive, write-up, sold. Takes under 30 seconds.

Automated Reports — Daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports delivered to your inbox automatically. Track closing percentages, traffic, and rep performance without manual data entry.

Multi-Location — Compare all your stores on one report. Corporate, regional, and store-level access controls built in.

Fully Customizable — Your store's process, your rules. Board logic, outcome questions, and reports tailored to how you operate. Most changes done within 24 hours at no extra cost.

Cloud-Based — Nothing to install. Nothing to buy. Works on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and any web browser. Access your floor from anywhere in the world.

WHO USES SKYUP

• Automotive Dealerships
• Furniture Stores
• RV & Boat Dealerships
• Appliance Stores
• Flooring Stores
• Jewelry Stores
• Pool & Spa Stores
• Mobile Phone Stores
• Any retail store with salespeople on the floor

RESULTS

Clients consistently report a 10–15% increase in sales after implementing SkyUp. Accountability creates results — when reps know every interaction is tracked, they stretch further for every sale.

Trusted by 1,000+ retail locations across the US, Canada, and Australia, including AutoNation, Open Road Auto Group, Toyota of Bellevue, Northside Lexus, RC Willey, Dunk & Bright Furniture, Value City Furniture, and American Signature Furniture.

Authorized login credentials are required to use this application. Contact your SkyUp administrator or reach us at info@skyupsystem.com to get set up.
